description: The Symantec PGP Cryptographic Engine is a FIPS 140-2 validated software only cryptographic module. The module implements the cryptographic functions for Symantec Encryption products, including the Symantec Drive Encryption, Symantec Desktop Email, Symantec File Share Encryption, Symantec Encryption Desktop, and Symantec Gateway Email.
